text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"This is the retort when asked, 'What is a 
shiroururi?' 'I know not. But if one 
exists, it must look just like this monk's 
face.'"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, hehe... "Shiroururi"... pfft. What 
does it look like? Like this?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, this person is... way too 
eccentric! Hehe, I should make a 4-panel 
comic out of this. Like this...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Drawing on your handouts again...! Copy 
down the board notes instead of doodling. 
Confiscated."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah... I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Kiseki-san, again? Ye just 
cannae resist doodlin', can ye?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, ideas just kept popping into my 
head... and I really wanted to write them 
down..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Not during class, though. You need to 
focus and take it seriously.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki, shall we go apologize together? 
I'm sure the teacher will forgive us if we 
just explain!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's exactly why! I'll go by 
myself and apologize fair and square...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"‘Do not look away from what you have 
done... Redemption begins now!’"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's only by honestly admitting 
where you went wrong that you can move 
forward, Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text: Pfft, haha...! Wait, "Shiroururi-kun"...?

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...! *ahem* So you've come, Kiseki-san. 
Here are your worksheets. Please let this 
be a lesson to you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Were you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Teacher, did you see my doodle and... 
burst out laughing...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No way, that's just... that's just too 
much...! Nnnngh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to flesh out this sketch 
even more! Let's do thisssssss!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You want to polish up that doodle and 
turn it into a piece that'll make the 
teacher burst out laughing?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So I want a bunch of different girls 
to read it and give me their feedback! 
Even though it's still just rough 
storyboards!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Sounds like fun! Leave it to 
me, Kiseki! Boo's gonna read it perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! ...Honestly, you're supposed 
to take class seriously!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Look at the back of the classroom! 
Are all the manga on top of these shelves 
Kiseki-san's?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! I checked out a bunch of them 
for research!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki~! The math teacher told me what 
manga the Japanese teacher likes!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! Thank you! Nice communication, 
Blast-chan! I gotta research that right 
away, too!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, there are even more of them!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Teacher! Pardon the intrusiooon!!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Kiseki-san. Please lower your voice a 
bit in the staff room...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ehehe. Excuse me! I came to turn in my 
assignment.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Submissions? I'm pretty sure we didn't 
have any assignments, though—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is the assignment I racked my brain 
over! Please read it carefully and grade 
it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely make you burst 
out laughing.

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...*ahem*. Honestly, you silly girl... 
Did you think I'd laugh so easily when you 
warned me beforehand?"

text_block_list.name: Japanese Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hee-hee-hee-hee!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...And that's what happened! It was a 
huge success, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I listened to the whole story from Kiseki. 
Seeing her satisfied smile warmed my heart 
too.
choice_data_list:
Still, doodling during class is a no-no, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'll... be careful about that! 
...Probably.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
O-Osu!! Whenever I feel the urge to draw, 
I'll picture Master's face!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Juuust kidding. Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Control... my impulses...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds so cool if I could pull 
it off...! Understood, I'll definitely 
master it!
